data_point: No dedicated accounting or finance person visible
weight: medium at SMB, low at MM, not scored at ENT

prompt.task: Look at the people shown on the team or about page and decide whether anyone has a dedicated finance or accounting role.
prompt.definition: Describes a company too small to have hired finance yet.
yes_when: A team list is shown and nobody has a finance or accounting title
no_when: Someone has a title like CFO, Controller, Head of Finance, Finance Manager, Accountant
watch_out_for: Answer 'yes' only when you actually see a team list
Investors and advisors don't count as team
Having a finance person is never a negative at mid-size or larger companies

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

web_search.why: Based on absence; not finding a finance person on the web proves nothing.

examples.input_excerpt: Our team: Jane Doe, CEO; Sam Lee, CTO; Ana Ruiz, Designer; Tom Park, Engineer

output.evidence_quote: Jane Doe, CEO; Sam Lee, CTO; Ana Ruiz, Designer; Tom Park, Engineer
output.reason: Four team members shown, none in finance.
